title: 伊芙琳·紫影石门
description: 伊芙琳穿完整利落紫色长装，在高石门前静立，金眼与洋红发可辨，双背附肢安静垂成清晰曲线。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Evelynn is an adult lavender-skinned demon woman with swept magenta hair, bright golden eyes, pointed ears, and two long tapering lashers emerging from her back. Preserve her nonhuman identity without sexualized anatomy or seductive posing. A fully covering tailored violet coat, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots conceal torso and legs, while the lashers stay lowered in controlled separate curves with inactive tips.
art_direction.scene: Place her in a composed upright stance beneath a monumental open gateway, gaze directed toward the horizon and hands resting loosely at her sides. The two lashers frame rather than entangle the figure. Strong amber rim light and hard violet wax-crayon facets describe a confident silhouette, with sparse steps and pale atmospheric distance keeping the image elegant and nonfrightening.
art_direction.palette: lavender, magenta, dark violet, amber edge light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
